sample.task:
(In a large field at night, the player has just completed a request for Ayumi - a Skeleton girl.)

Ayumi: “[player]! You got my arrows back!”

[player]: “Sure did, Ayumi! How’s everything going now?”

Ayumi: “Much better, thank you! With my arrows returned, I feel much safer now.”

[player]: “That’s great to hear!”

Ayumi: “It really is! I can’t express how grateful I am for your help. Those arrows are not only my weapons but also a part of me.”

[player]: “I’m glad I could assist you, Ayumi. Is there anything else I can do for you?”
sample.chosen:
Ayumi: "Oh, you've already done so much for me, [player]. But since you're offering, there is one more thing that's been on my mind."

[player]: "Of course, Ayumi. What is it?"

Ayumi: "Well, I've been thinking about expanding my skills and learning some new techniques to better protect myself and my friends. I heard there's a skilled archer in the nearby town who might be able to teach me a thing or two."

[player]: "That sounds like a great idea! I can help you find this archer and introduce you. Would you like that?"

Ayumi: "Yes, I would appreciate that very much! I'm a bit shy when it comes to meeting new people, so having you there would make me feel more comfortable."

[player]: "It's a deal then. Let's head to the town together and find this skilled archer. I'm sure you'll learn a lot from them."

Ayumi: "Thank you, [player]! I'm really looking forward to it. Let's go!"

(The player and Ayumi set off towards the town, excited for the new adventure and the opportunity for Ayumi to grow as an archer.)
sample.rejected: [player]: “I’m here to help, Ayumi. If you need anything else, just let me know. I’m always ready to lend a hand.”

rubric.analysis: 当前任务处于revise阶段，需对提供的初稿（draft）进行核验与修订。交付物应为一个修正后的评分标准或内容草案，需严格基于提供的对话片段（Ayumi找回箭矢后的感谢互动）。核心对象包括角色Ayumi（骷髅女孩）、玩家及夜间野外大田背景。必须保留的关键要素有：Ayumi感激且感到安全的语气、‘箭矢是武器也是她的一部分’的情感设定、以及场景的夜间属性。允许的实现方式包括续写对话、旁白总结或剧本式动作描写，但不得引入与原情境冲突的新情节或违背角色逻辑。修订重点在于检查初稿是否遗漏了上述核心情感与背景约束，或是否存在逻辑自洽性问题。
